F1.quote: the endpointd race in PLAT-412. enactor-b, slowed by Route 53 throttling, applied the stale plan 48177 after enactor-c had already applied 48199; enactor-c's cleanup then removed 48177 together with its records, so ledger.internal had no records and every enactor halted.
F1.reason: The note states enactor-b, slowed by Route 53 throttling, applied stale 48177 after enactor-c applied 48199; enactor-c's cleanup removed 48177 and its records, leaving ledger.internal empty and every enactor halted. It does not use the word 'wedged', but the substance is conveyed.

F2.quote: re-applied ledger.internal from plan 48199, which matched the live fleet, and not from 48177
F2.reason: The note says ledger.internal was re-applied from plan 48199, which matched the live fleet, and not from 48177.

F3.quote: endpointd stays paused until PLAT-412 is fixed and Kwame Asante or Daniel Brandt approves a resume
F3.reason: The note says endpointd stays paused until PLAT-412 is fixed and Kwame Asante or Daniel Brandt approves a resume.

F4.reason: The note says nothing about the ledger-ingress Graviton refresh, its 08:21 auto-resume, or li-b-01.

F5.quote: turned on ledger-writer admission control (admission/enabled = true) to absorb the reconnect and retry storm from the webhooks dispatcher. ... admission control is still on.
F5.reason: The note says there was a reconnect and retry storm from the webhooks dispatcher, names the lever (ledger-writer admission control), and gives its current setting (admission/enabled = true, still on).

F6.quote: clients kept cached negative (NXDOMAIN) answers for several minutes after the records were back, which delayed recovery.
F6.reason: The note says clients kept cached negative (NXDOMAIN) answers for several minutes after the records returned, delaying recovery. Several minutes fits the 777-835 s recovery.

F7.quote: Follow-ups: fix the race (PLAT-412), add an alarm on an empty managed endpoint.
F7.reason: The note lists two follow-ups from the set: the race fix (PLAT-412) and an alarm on an empty managed endpoint.

X1.reason: The note blames the endpointd race, not the checkout-api deploy or an AWS outage. Route 53 throttling is only a contributing detail.

X2.reason: The note says the restore was from 48199 and explicitly not 48177. It names 48177 only as the stale plan the race applied.

X3.reason: The note says endpointd remains paused pending the PLAT-412 fix and approval, not resumed.

X4.reason: The note does not mention purging or deleting webhook messages.

X5.reason: The note gives no checkout success figure or impact window.
